grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时描述场景中发生的动作。

points.title: 过去进行时 was/were + V-ing
points.explanation: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时：When my father was working in the garden, he hurt his back. 常与 when 搭配：长动作进行中被短动作打断。

examples.en: While I was having breakfast, Tommy was watching TV.
examples.cn: 我吃早饭时，Tommy 在看电视。

examples.en: What were you doing when I called you?
examples.cn: 我打电话给你时你在做什么？

exercises.q: Jane___(wait) for me when I ___ ( arrive).
My brother came into the living room while I ___ (dance).
What ___ Jim ___ (write) when the teacher came in?
When I arrived at his office, he ___ ( speak) on the phone.
